article.title: Give up
article.description: Meaning: to stop trying, or to quit a habit. Example 1: 'Don't give up, you're almost finished!' Example 2: 'He gave up smoking last year.' Grammar note: separable phrasal verb — 'give it up' is also correct, 'give up it' is not.
article.content: Meaning: to stop trying, or to quit a habit. Example 1: 'Don't give up, you're almost finished!' Example 2: 'He gave up smoking last year.' Grammar note: separable phrasal verb — 'give it up' is also correct, 'give up it' is not.

generated.caption:
Feeling like giving up on a tough task? Don't! Our phrasal verb today is 'give up', meaning to stop trying or quit a habit. For instance: 'Don't give up, you're almost finished!' Remember, you can also say 'give it up', but not 'give up it'. Keep going! 💪

Save this tip & follow @theenglishvault for daily English lessons!
generated.script:
English mein 'give up' ka use kab karte hain, ismein aksar log galti karte hain, pata hai?
Toh suno, 'give up' ke do main matlab hain. Pehla, jab aap koi cheez try karna band kar dete ho, to stop trying. Jaise, 'Don't give up, you're almost finished!' Yani haar mat maano, tum bas khatam karne hi waale ho. Aur doosra matlab hai to quit a habit, jab aap koi aadat chhod dete ho. Aur haan, 'give it up' bol sakte ho, 'give up it' galat hai!
Toh ab se jab bhi aapko bolna ho ki koshish karna band kar diya ya koi habit chhod di, toh use karna 'give up'! Ab samajh aaya?
Comment mein batao, aapne kaunsi habit 'give up' ki hai? Aur aise hi English tips ke liye follow The English Vault!

slides.body: The phrasal verb "give up" has two main meanings. Firstly, it means to stop trying, like in 'Don't give up, you're almost finished!' Secondly, it refers to quitting a habit, for example, 'He gave up smoking last year.' Remember, "give up" is a separable phrasal verb; you can say 'give it up,' but 'give up it' is incorrect.
slides.hindiSummary: "Give up" का अर्थ है कोशिश करना छोड़ देना या किसी आदत को त्याग देना।
